explanation: RG01: forward the plan's declared memory limit to the build through the existing RSS watchdog (RLIMIT_AS is reserved for run so sanitizer virtual memory is preserved) and short-circuit a build stopped by RSS/output-budget exhaustion as engine_failed/resource_exhaustion before any run or candidate decision. RG02: replace file redirection with bounded per-stream pipe reads that stop at output_capture_limit_bytes while consuming, keep reading until actual EOF or the existing deadline/cancellation/RSS/cap stops the run (a dead leader is NOT EOF and no fresh drain timer is added), mark a capped stream truncated/inconclusive, then digest/excerpt the bounded spool. The owned process-group id is captured at spawn and used for termination so the group can still be killed after its leader is reaped. Exact-cap output followed by real EOF stays complete; below-cap late descendant bytes are retained.
